My first time with the blow
Yeah, yesterday I had my first real experience with the 'white lady'.  I did a line or two a couple days ago but I guess the first time I did it, I really didn't get the full effect, it's more of a loading stage.  I did my first line at 6:30pm and felt nothing, then about 30 minutes later I did a huge line and thats where it really started for me.  I was just so open about talking, and I mean talking about everything, things I would never talk to normal.  For the next 3 hours I did about a line every 30 minutes until about 10:15pm.  It was like everything I did felt good, the only bad thing is I cannot sleep worth anything, I laid down at 1am and probably didn't sleep until 3am, that part sucked.  I'll definitely do it for another month or so, that way I don't get hooked on that stuff, but I've done weed and this is so much better I hate to say it.  You can sleep, function, and you don't eat your whole kitchen up, or anything for that matter.
